content: Retail research platforms (Simply Wall St, TipRanks, Seeking Alpha, Zacks, Morningstar) share a pattern: visual/numeric fundamental scoring (Simply Wall St snowflake, Seeking Alpha Quant Rating from 100+ metrics, Zacks #1-5 rank from earnings revisions, TipRanks Smart Score from analyst/insider/hedge-fund/news/technical/fundamental blend), stock screeners, portfolio tracking tools, news aggregation, and community/expert analysis content. None execute trades.
